title: Stainless Steel Funnels, Large Small Funnel Set of 3, Food Grade Mini Metal Kitchen Funnel for Transferring Essential Oils, Liquid, Fluid, Small Funnels for Filling Bottles Flask Cooking
description:
About this item
Stainless Steel Funnel Size: Metal stainless steel construction funnels include three sizes:Large Mouth: 2.95" - Medium Mouth: 2.24" - Small Mouth: 1.77" .easy to clean, nest nicely and come with a clip-ring that keeps them together for storage.
Premium Stainless Steel: These stainless steel funnels are made of food grade stainless steel, non-toxic and sturdy. Premium material makes these small funnels have a long usage time and resists breaking, bending, scratching, rusting.
Stainless Steel Funnels: Each Stainless Steel funnel has a perfectly narrow stem, ideal for filling small bottles and containers while keeping the kitchen counter free from spills. Each funnel’s stem is equipped with an indent (air release channel), which allows funnels to vent and allows contents to flow better.
Widely Used: Stainless Steel Funnels for Kitchen Perfect for adding salt, pepper, herbs or spices into shakers or jars; transferring oils and vinegars into cruets or small decorative bottles for gifts; adding powdered drink mixes into water bottles and much more.
Easy To Clean And Store: Metal stainless steel construction funnels include three sizes, easy to clean, nest nicely and come with a clip-ring that keeps them together for storage.

reviews_1s:
In the set of 3, only the largest funnel can be used. The others are too small for doing any task including cooking or hobbies.

Except you buy them for kis toy, I do not recomended for any other tasks!It's two pieces of metal melded together and the interior has a rim at the base of the cone, meaning your spices will collect at the bottom of the funnel and not flow into the tube. May not be important to everyone but if you care about precise measurements, there will always be clumps of residue left behind inside the funnel at the base where it connects to the tube. Seems like the worst way to make a funnel.I just received the 3pc mini funnel set and I immediately knew the sizes were going to be off when I opened the package, they were too big. I bought this set based on the measurements of the spout sizes given in the 2nd picture of the listing. The set is shown as having spout sizes of .16 inch, .24 inch, and .39 inch.

I bought this set solely because I needed the smallest one with the supposed .16 inch measurement. It wouldn't fit in to the container that I bought it for and upon measuring it, it shows as .24 inch. The medium one is .32 inch and the largest is .5 inch. All 3 have incorrect measurements. Please fix the listing and either remove that picture or correct it. I'm sure a lot of the people who are purchasing the mini 3 set of funnels are going to use it to fill a small container and if the measurements of the spout are incorrect, it can be useless, as it is in my case.

***** For anyone reading this, the actual measurements of the spouts for the mini 3pc funnel set are .24", .32", and .5". *****Funnels are not usable since the sizes are really small.This funnel is either aluminum/ ton or a toxic inferior form of stainless steel with nickel in it and poses significant health risks. Particularly if you pour hot liquids thru it Brand name not in funnel as depicted in photo of product. Very suspect to meProduct does not work. It has a flat area thru funnel that any powder you use gets stuck and you either need to use a spoon to scratch it down the funnel or leave it there… do not recommend. Definitely am returning this item.There is a lip on the inside of the bottom of the funnel so it is hard for dry items to go through and it gets stuck on the lip.These are not functional as funnels for powders. The shape is curved and there is a ridge at the top of the spout. If you put a tablespoon of powder in the funnel a third of it will sit around the ridge of the spout and not pour through the funnel. They might work ok if all you are pouring is liquids.Funnels have a lip inside and everything gets stuck. Waste of money don't buy this junk.The funnels all have a large lip inside at the base of the funnel before entering the tube part you put inside whatever you're trying to fill. The lip is large enough that it makes these funnels useless for their intended purpose. No one wants a tiny funnel that has a massive lip blocking the flow of whatever they need to funnel down into something else.
